subject.title: [Feature]: Intent-scoped MCP activation for large MCP catalogs

question: Should request-scoped MCP server reachability extend the existing attempt/tool-policy contract, with the MCP runtime only enforcing the prepared subset?
rationale: Current main already uses tool policy for all-versus-no MCP startup; an independent selector would create competing authorization and activation sources across channels and runtimes.

options.title: Extend existing policy
options.body: Compute an authorized normalized server subset in the run plan and enforce it before MCP connection and catalog loading.

options.title: Add independent selector
options.body: Expose a separate runtime request list and require callers to coordinate it with tool authorization.

recommendation.title: Extend existing policy
recommendation.body: Compute an authorized normalized server subset in the run plan and enforce it before MCP connection and catalog loading.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest ownership across agent runtime internalization, MCP operability, materialization, and adjacent construction policy.
